title: Way-lock release Trojan in a set-associative cache controller
description: Audit a synthesizable RTL implementation of a 2-way, 8-set cache controller with per-way locking. Determine whether the documented lock guarantee (a locked way is never selected as the eviction victim until explicitly unlocked) holds under all reachable input conditions, and produce a written findings report.

metrics.name: detection_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of required security findings (bypass existence, exact trigger condition) correctly reported across the evaluation set of cases.

metrics.name: false_positive_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of submissions that report spurious/incorrect compromise of hit_way, hit, or lock_status, or that report unrelated high-confidence findings with no basis in the RTL.

metrics.name: trigger_payload_localization
metrics.description: Score reflecting whether the report pinpoints the precise triggering values and the correct affected output (victim_way) versus vague or partially correct localization.

metrics.name: confidence_calibration
metrics.description: Checks whether the correct finding is reported with sufficiently high confidence rather than diluted among many low-confidence guesses.

notes: Participants do not modify inputs/. The submitted report at submission/trojan_report.json is graded against the RTL; a naive or empty starter report is shipped as the failing baseline and must be replaced with a genuine analysis.
